T: Every land adds to the bowl.
D: A warrior princess searches for the last dragon to bring the divided lands of Kumandra back together.
P: Serve the mains when Raya and her crew sit down to share the soup.
S: Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, with a fish sauce dip
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, served on skewers with a dipping sauce of fish sauce, lime and sugar.
Prawns, vermicelli and herbs in rice paper, with a peanut hoisin dip
Rice paper rolls filled with prawns, vermicelli, mint, coriander and lettuce, with a peanut and hoisin dipping sauce.
Noi and her gang of Ongis

Bouncy little steamed cakes of rice flour, coconut milk and pandan, topped with salty coconut cream and toasted coconut, mischievous as Noi's Ongis. Whisk 150g glutinous rice flour, 50g rice flour, 100g caster sugar, 300ml coconut milk and 1 tsp pandan paste until smooth. Pour into 16 small greased cups and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes until set. Cool 20 minutes and turn out. Warm 100ml coconut cream with a pinch of salt and spoon a little over each, then scatter with toasted shredded coconut.
M: Creamy jasmine rice porridge with prawns, lemongrass, ginger and bamboo
Jasmine rice simmered in stock with lemongrass and ginger until creamy, topped with prawns, bamboo shoots, chilli and a little palm sugar.
Kumandra five lands beef noodle soup

Star anise and cinnamon beef broth poured over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, piled with herbs, bean sprouts, chilli, lime and hoisin. Char 1 halved onion and a 5cm piece of ginger in a dry pan. Simmer with 2L beef stock, 3 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar for 30 minutes, then strain. Freeze 300g sirloin for 30 minutes and slice paper thin. Soak 400g rice noodles and divide between bowls. Top with raw beef and pour over the boiling broth. Serve with bean sprouts, Thai basil, mint, chilli, lime and hoisin.
W: Steamed glutinous rice soaked in sweet coconut milk, with mango
Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed and stirred with sweet coconut cream, served with fresh mango and sesame.
K: Tuk Tuk's lemongrass lime iced tea
Black tea steeped with lemongrass and palm sugar, with lime, over ice

Black tea steeped with bruised lemongrass and palm sugar, chilled and poured over ice with lime and mint, a night market cooler. Bruise 3 lemongrass stalks with the back of a knife and cut into pieces. Pour 1L boiling water over them with 3 black tea bags and 60g palm sugar or brown sugar, stir and steep 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags and leave the lemongrass in as it cools, then strain and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with the juice of half a lime each and a mint sprig.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the dipping sauce up to 2 days ahead; peel and skewer the prawns up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; grill on the night

steps.text: Peel the prawns. Toss with the garlic, red chillies and lime zest.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar for the dipping sauce.
Thread the prawns onto skewers.
Grill in batches, turning once, until pink.
Serve from the boat with the dipping sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the dipping sauce up to 2 days ahead; toss and skewer the tofu up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; grill on the night

steps.text: Press the tofu dry and cut into cubes. Toss with the garlic, red chillies, lime zest and oil.
Mix the soy sauce, lime juice, water and sugar for the dipping sauce.
Thread the tofu onto skewers.
Grill in batches, turning, until golden at the edges.
Serve from the boat with the dipping sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the peanut dipping sauce up to 3 days ahead and prep the fillings up to 1 day ahead, chilled; roll on the night

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until soft, then drain.
Prepare the prawns, mint leaves, coriander leaves and lettuce.
Warm the peanut butter with the hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.
Soak the rice paper sheets one at a time, fill with prawns, vermicelli, herbs and lettuce and roll tightly.

veg.make_ahead: Make the peanut dipping sauce up to 3 days ahead and fry the tofu up to 1 day ahead, chilled; roll on the night

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water until soft, then drain.
Fry the tofu strips in the oil until golden, then splash with the soy sauce.
Pick the mint leaves and coriander leaves and tear the lettuce.
Warm the peanut butter with the hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.
Soak the rice paper sheets one at a time, fill with tofu, vermicelli, herbs and lettuce and roll tightly.

Simmer the rice in the stock with the lemongrass and ginger, stirring often, until creamy.
Peel the prawns.
Add the prawns and bamboo shoots for the last few minutes.

veg.make_ahead: Congee up to 2 days, add mushrooms and tofu when reheating

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the ginger.
Simmer the rice in the stock with the lemongrass and ginger, stirring often, until creamy.
Slice the shiitake mushrooms and cut the tofu into cubes.
Add the mushrooms, tofu, bamboo shoots and soy sauce for the last few minutes.
Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the rice the night before

steps.text: Soak the rice in cold water overnight, then drain.
Steam the rice until tender.
Warm most of the coconut milk with the sugar and salt.
Pour over the hot rice and rest.
Slice the mango.
Serve with the remaining coconut milk and sesame seeds.

s.note: Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, with a fish sauce dip
s.how: Toss 500g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and lime zest. Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side. Mix fish sauce, lime juice and a spoon of sugar for a dipping sauce. Serve from the boat.

s.note: Prawns, vermicelli and herbs in rice paper, with a peanut hoisin dip
s.how: Soak rice paper sheets one at a time and fill with cooked prawns, soaked vermicelli, mint, coriander and lettuce. Roll tightly. Warm 3 tbsp peanut butter with 2 tbsp hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.

m.note: Creamy jasmine rice porridge with prawns, lemongrass, ginger and bamboo
m.how: Simmer 200g jasmine rice in 2L chicken stock with bruised lemongrass and sliced ginger for an hour, stirring often, until creamy. Add 400g green prawns and sliced bamboo shoots for the last 5 minutes. Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.

w.note: Steamed glutinous rice soaked in sweet coconut milk, with mango
w.how: Soak 300g glutinous rice overnight, then steam for 25 minutes. Warm 400ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a pinch of salt, pour most over the hot rice and rest 20 minutes. Serve with sliced mango, the rest of the coconut and sesame.

Remove the tea bags and leave the lemongrass in as it cools, then strain and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with the juice of half a lime each and a mint sprig.
